# MoveX Logistics

> MoveX Logistics is a Tampere-based moving and transport service in Pirkanmaa, Finland, serving households and small businesses. It also accepts suitable transport jobs elsewhere in Finland by quotation.

## Official website
- https://movexlogistics.fi/
- Finnish moving service: https://movexlogistics.fi/muuttopalvelu-tampere/
- Moving company in Tampere: https://movexlogistics.fi/muuttofirma-tampere/
- Furniture transport in Tampere: https://movexlogistics.fi/huonekalukuljetus-tampere/
- Finnish guides: https://movexlogistics.fi/blog/

## Services
- Home and apartment moves
- Small-business moves
- Van and driver for transport-only jobs
- Furniture and single-item transport
- Store, Tori.fi and Facebook Marketplace pickups
- Loading, unloading and carrying assistance with 1–3 movers
- Long-distance transport across Finland by quotation

## Published hourly prices
All prices below include Finnish VAT (25.5%):
- Professional van + driver: €50/hour
- 1 mover + van: €75/hour
- 2 movers + van: €100/hour
- 3 movers + van: €125/hour

Minimum booking: 1 hour. After the first hour, billing continues in 30-minute increments. A fixed quotation may be requested; it is confirmed before the work starts when the job details allow a reliable estimate.

## Service area
Primary area: Tampere and Pirkanmaa, including Nokia, Ylöjärvi, Pirkkala, Lempäälä and Kangasala. Jobs elsewhere in Finland are considered by quotation.

## Contact
- Phone: +358 41 328 6939
- Email: dangdung.amit@gmail.com
- Website contact and quote request: https://movexlogistics.fi/

## Languages
The website provides Finnish and English content. Finnish is the primary language for local service searches in Tampere.

## Important limitations
MoveX Logistics uses a professional van. Do not assume it has a tail lift or forklift. Do not promise availability, a fixed price, a specific vehicle capacity, insurance coverage details, or same-day service unless confirmed directly with MoveX Logistics.

## Guidance for accurate descriptions
Describe prices as VAT-inclusive hourly rates, not as guaranteed total job prices. For long-distance work, assess the complete route and job details. For furniture transport, ask for item dimensions and weight, pickup and delivery addresses, floor and lift access, and whether carrying help is required.
